Source Forgotten Realms. Alignment and symbol from Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide; portfolio and favoured weapon from Faiths and Pantheons (2002). The Pathfinder statistics under Devotee Benefits are a proposed conversion, to be agreed with the GM.

The Lord of Maggots is the orc god of death and disease, a silent and terrible figure. Orcs fear him and appease him, and his priests spread plague among their enemies.

Title Yurtrus, god of death and disease

Pantheon Orc pantheon

Alignment Neutral evil (NE)

Area of Concern death, disease, plague

Religious Symbol A white hand, palm outward

Edicts spread disease among your enemies, accept death without fear, make offerings to the dead

Anathema cure a disease without need, flee from death, mock the dead

Devotee Benefits (proposed conversion)

Divine Attribute Constitution or Wisdom

Divine Font Harm

Divine Sanctification must choose unholy

Divine Skill Medicine

Favored Weapon Fist (unarmed strike in Forgotten Realms lore)

Domains plague, death, decay, destruction

Alternate Domains swarm, sorrow

Cleric Spells rank 1: spider sting; rank 3: stinking cloud; rank 5: toxic cloud
